messages:
Ava (CS): Kicking off a warmup/priming sync for @Kai — dedicated pool goes live tomorrow. Need final quota confirmation and autoscale policy sign-off.

Sam (Eng): Current reserved = 8x A100-equivalent GPUs. Baseline throughput planned: 120 qps, burst cap ~900 qps with autoscale headroom ~2x. Does that align with expected traffic profile?

Riley (SRE): Proposed test window: 2h total. Ramp 0->50% in 10m, 50->100% in next 40m, 60m steady soak, then 30m spike probes. We'll validate latency p50/p95 and error rates. Objections?

Kai (Customer): Sounds good. One constraint: keep max context tokens to 1024 during the test. Also please route 5% traffic to a canary variant with fallback enabled.

Ava (CS): Noted on tokens + canary. Also need confirmation that prefix/KV caching will be enabled for the run. Sam?

Sam (Eng): Yes — prefix caching ON. We're serving a quantized q4f16 variant for cost. Autoscaler rules: scale-up at sustained GPU util >=70% for 30s, scale-down at <40% for 2m. That should avoid flapping during the ramp.

Riley (SRE): Copy. I'll kick the load harness at the agreed window. Test command I'll use: 

Riley (SRE): ```
./loadtest --account kai-corp --qps 600 --duration 2h --tokens 1024 --canary 5%
```

Ava (CS): I've shared the preflight checklist and runbook with Kai over email. @Kai, can you ack the billing delta? Estimated incremental cost for the reserved surge: ~$1,200.

Kai (Customer): Ack, finance greenlit it. Also FYI we'll capture output examples for a short quality pass — we saw slight drift at longer contexts in staging.

Sam (Eng): After soak we'll run a quick embedding/rerank smoke: batchsize=64, 10k samples. Should surface any regressions.

Riley (SRE): Starting now. I'll paste logs if we see error spikes. ops-bot will post alerts into the thread.

ops-bot: Scheduled job PRIME-238 started at 1798504500 — dashboard: https://ops.redwood/status/PRIME-238 :satellite:

Ava (CS): Thanks everyone. Deliverables after the run: perf histograms (latency p50/p95/p99), error traces, autoscale events timeline, and a brief customer-facing summary. I'll own the debrief with Kai tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
